title: Assyrian branch settles the 'old Holy Land' and is later destroyed
summary: Matt tells of Assyrian branch settles the 'old Holy Land' and is later destroyed, about Assyrian era at eastern Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I believe a branch of the Assyrians that moved into what I'm calling this old Holy Land

plain: A researcher known as Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, says he believes a branch of the Assyrians, an ancient people of the Middle East, moved into a part of eastern Turkey that he calls the "old Holy Land". He says this group was later destroyed. If true, the area would hold a forgotten chapter of sacred history.
